The ergonomic pistol-grip handle provides a comfortable and secure hold during extended use, reducing fatigue and improving manoeuvrability. Built with a durable construction and a well-ventilated motor housing, the DSP02-180 is designed for long-lasting performance. The variable speed control allows you to adjust the intensity of the polish to suit different surfaces and materials.
